title: County condo purchases for fire-displaced kūpuna
summary: An amendment has added the unit's appraisal report to a resolution that authorizes buying a Lahaina condo unit for up to $278,000. A county housing testifier said federal Community Development Block Grant funds would pay for it. The unit would serve a county housing program for kūpuna, which houses 10 people in 8 units, while over half of its 41 waitlisted households are still in FEMA housing.
